authorization_boundary: The authorized Gate D envelope specified one fresh development GPU. That GPU was provisioned and terminated. No second development GPU may be provisioned without renewed Owner authorization.

cleanup.route: creator EXIT cleanup using the full exact pod ID

failure.primary: The detached creator used datetime.fromisoformat on the Prime CLI created_at value 2026-08-13 21:44:46 UTC, which Python rejects.
failure.secondary: The creator script path was edited in place while its systemd service was still reading it. Both complete static versions pass bash -n, but the live process later reported a syntax error, so the execution was treated as ambiguous and its EXIT cleanup terminated the pod.

gate_f_boundary: Gate F remains unused and cannot begin because Gate D readiness did not pass.
readiness_boundary: No candidate was frozen and no holdback plaintext was released, so this is not a readiness score or a burned readiness evaluation.
remediation: Accept and test the Prime CLI YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS UTC created_at format in the exact-ID controller.
Never edit an orchestration script that may be executing; run only a content-addressed immutable copy whose digest was precommitted.
Repeat every quote, identity, watchdog, data, security, and zero-resource preflight before any future authorized provision.
